Instrumentation events

Source: R/monitoring.R
monitoring.Rd

Port of jax.monitoring. Code points are marked as named events; every time an event is reached the registered listeners are called, for example to send it to a metrics collector.

Usage

monitoring_record_event(event, ...)

monitoring_record_event_duration_secs(event, duration, ...)

monitoring_record_event_time_span(event, start_time, end_time, ...)

monitoring_record_scalar(event, value, ...)

monitoring_register_event_listener(callback)

monitoring_register_event_duration_secs_listener(callback)

monitoring_register_event_time_span_listener(callback)

monitoring_register_scalar_listener(callback)

monitoring_clear_event_listeners()

monitoring_unregister_event_listener(callback)

monitoring_unregister_event_duration_listener(callback)

monitoring_unregister_event_time_span_listener(callback)

monitoring_unregister_scalar_listener(callback)

Arguments

event

Event name.

...

Named metadata passed to the listeners.

duration

Duration in seconds.

start_time, end_time

Times in seconds.

value

A number.

callback

A listener: a function of the arguments of the matching record function.

Value

NULL, invisibly.

Details

jaxR itself records, each with a fun_name argument, the events "/jax/core/compile/jaxpr_trace_duration" (tracing a function for jit()), "/jax/core/compile/jaxpr_to_mlir_module_duration" (lowering to StableHLO) and "/jax/core/compile/backend_compile_duration" (XLA compilation): the start time as a scalar, then the duration and the time span.

Examples

monitoring_register_event_listener(function(event, ...) message("event: ", event))
monitoring_record_event("/my/event")
#> event: /my/event
monitoring_clear_event_listeners()
